verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a security and compliance platform, so vendor inventory and third-party risk review is a fair axis for it. However, the evidence pack never mentions vendor management, vendor inventories, vendor security reviews, data-access tracking, or review cadence. The cited material covers cloud and GitHub monitoring, MDM, policies, code security, the Trust Center and MCP access, none of which is third-party vendor risk review.

support.subject: As an operations lead, third-party vendors are inventoried and risk-reviewed in the platform — security posture, data access, review cadence — instead of a spreadsheet
